Baseline.description: A saved comparator forecast, without any future outcome values.

Catalog.description: Versioned catalogue; batch reads use the batch's frozen mapping.

Cutoff.description: An explicitly published, selectable forecast batch.
Cutoff.title: Cutoff

Cutoffs.description: Supported combinations only; no interpolation to another cutoff.
Cutoffs.title: Cutoffs

DataHealth.description: Public quality summary for the active published release.
DataHealth.title: DataHealth

Error.description: Stable public failure code and safe user-facing description.
Error.title: Error

Evaluation.description: Immutable evaluation, with failed and inconclusive results preserved.
Evaluation.title: Evaluation

Evidence.description: Persisted evidence whose availability is bounded by the decision cutoff.
Evidence.title: Evidence

Exclusion.description: A published ranking exclusion with its original reason codes.
Exclusion.title: Exclusion

Forecast.description: One tool's saved aggregate prediction or explicit unavailable result.
Forecast.title: Forecast

ForecastBatch.description: Frozen prediction payload; shared identity/time apply to every result.
ForecastBatch.title: ForecastBatch

Freshness.description: Published quality assessment, independent of model validation status.
Freshness.title: Freshness

Health.description: Process or repository readiness, without sensitive configuration.
Health.title: Health

HistoryPoint.description: One observed interval; missing counts remain null.
HistoryPoint.title: HistoryPoint

Interval.description: An interval already approved by the model owner's serving gate.
Interval.title: Interval

Metric.description: Published comparison, including common-row and interval diagnostics.
Metric.title: Metric

Outcome.description: Mature truth and saved errors, available only in a reveal response.
Outcome.title: Outcome

Provenance.description: Public immutable version references, never storage locations or secrets.
Provenance.title: Provenance

Ranking.description: Ordered representatives supplied by shared numerical policy.
Ranking.title: Ranking

Rankings.description: Published ordering and comparators; the API never recomputes rankings.
Rankings.title: Rankings

ReportLink.description: Public immutable report link without signed storage credentials.
ReportLink.title: ReportLink

Reveal.description: Separate mature outcomes and scores; never nested in a forecast DTO.
Reveal.title: Reveal

RevealRequest.description: A bounded user selection; scores are delegated to the model owner.
RevealRequest.title: RevealRequest

Score.description: Authoritative shortlist score with explicit undefined/insufficient states.
Score.title: Score

SourceHealth.description: Public source coverage; diagnostics contain no internal error strings.
SourceHealth.title: SourceHealth

Tool.description: Verified tool-to-package and organization mapping in one ecosystem.
Tool.title: Tool

Window.description: A UTC half-open measurement interval [start, end).
Window.title: Window
